title: Phase 1: Foundation - Rename, Bot Identity, Contact Types, Management Hierarchy, Frontend Branding
goal: Rename Reality Pandit to Realty Pandit, establish Panditji bot identity, add 5-type contact classification, add management hierarchy to Agent model, update frontend branding.

sub_tasks.title: Rename Reality Pandit to Realty Pandit
sub_tasks.output: Renamed across 9 files: system_prompt.ts, decision_engine.ts, seed.ts, templates.json, project.json, TASK-000.json, MASTER_MANUAL.md, PROJECT_REPORT.md, reality-pandit-dev.md

sub_tasks.title: Establish Bot Identity Panditji
sub_tasks.output: Updated system_prompt.ts (core behavior + greeting), decision_engine.ts (outbound script), templates.json (welcome message)

sub_tasks.title: Add contact_type field to Contact model
sub_tasks.output: Added contact_type to schema.prisma (BUYER_TENANT, SELLER_LANDLORD, PARTNER_AGENT, MANAGEMENT, UNKNOWN), updated webhooks.ts and voice.ts to set UNKNOWN on new contacts, added contact_type index

sub_tasks.title: Add Management Hierarchy to Agent model
sub_tasks.output: Updated Agent model: role expanded to super_boss/manager/employee, added reports_to self-relation for hierarchy. Added PartnerAgent model for Phase 2.

sub_tasks.title: Update Frontend Branding
sub_tasks.output: Updated index.html title to 'Realty Pandit - Dashboard'

acceptance_criteria: All references to 'Reality Pandit' replaced with 'Realty Pandit'
Contact model has contact_type field with 5 values
Agent model has management hierarchy (super_boss, manager, employee)
result_summary: Phase 1 Foundation complete. All branding renamed, Panditji identity established, 5-type contact classification added to DB schema, management hierarchy added to Agent model, PartnerAgent model prepared for Phase 2.
